invented_facts: Local AI capability will reduce recurring cloud workstation costs.
The Aurora 14 runs models up to 30 billion parameters without noting that this requires a configuration with at least 64 GB of memory.
Using the Aurora 14 will eliminate waits for cloud sync, reduce the number of device types, or simplify fleet management.
Storage is user-upgradeable; the spec explicitly confirms this only for memory.
Engineers can work offline on client drawings and sync them when connectivity returns.
Cloud workstations will remain for peak loads while daily tasks shift locally.
Q4 availability establishes a Q4 deployment timeline.
notes: The sequence has three appropriately framed emails with one CTA each, but email 2 exceeds 120 words. Several cost, workflow, and management benefits are presented as established facts without support from the attachments.
